buzz.title: Daily Buzz
buzz.content:
MOCK RUN — test sheet, not for air

DAILY BUZZ · MON NOV 16

━━ LOCAL ━━

1) LAST DAY AT THE MANCELONA BUCK POLE
• The 72nd Mancelona Buck Pole closes tonight at 6:30 PM
• It opened at daybreak Sunday, when firearm deer season opened
• Prizes for first deer, heaviest, widest rack and most points
➜ TAKE: Some towns have a parade. Mancelona has a pole full of bucks, and you've got until 6:30 to get one on it.
➜ BAIT: Biggest deer your family ever got, and how much has the story grown?

2) BOARDMAN RIVER WALL REPAIRS COULD START WITHIN WEEKS
• A local infrastructure story with possible downtown impact
• Timing is "within weeks," not a start date for this morning
➜ TAKE: A wall along the river most of us walk past without thinking about, until the work starts.
➜ BAIT: Does a repair like this change how you get around downtown?

━━ NATIONAL ━━

3) AIR TRAVEL STILL CATCHING UP
• A nationwide ATC outage and ground stop hit over the weekend
• The FAA says the system is stable
• Airlines still expected to cancel 4,000 to 5,000 of about 41,000 flights on Sunday
• Monday travelers may feel the spillover, with Thanksgiving travel already on the calendar
➜ TAKE: If you're flying today, leave a wider window than the app says.
➜ BAIT: Anyone in your family stuck in an airport yesterday?

4) ROCK HALL CLASS OF THE WEEKEND
• Oasis, Queen Latifah, Sade, Joy Division/New Order, Iron Maiden and Rick Rubin were inducted Saturday
• Phil Collins got emotional, and Billy Idol performed
➜ TAKE: A pretty good Saturday night for a rock station.
➜ BAIT: Who on that list was the most overdue, and who surprised you?

5) SPACEX CATCHES STARSHIP WITH THE TOWER
• SpaceX caught Starship with the tower arms after its 15th test flight
➜ TAKE: They are catching a rocket with a pair of mechanical arms. That's a Monday kicker.
➜ BAIT: Would you watch a launch in person, or is the couch close enough?

6) A BIG MIDWEEK MEETING ON THE CALENDAR
• The Kremlin says Putin, Xi and Trump will meet Thursday, Nov 19, in Shenzhen, on the sidelines of APEC
➜ TAKE: A preview, not a recap. Thursday's a busy day in the world and in games, too.
➜ BAIT: Save this one for later in the hour if you need a world beat.

7) HORMUZ: CLAIMS OF MINES AND A DRONE ATTACK
• Iran's IRGC says two tankers hit mines and caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz
• Iran also claimed drone attacks on a U.S. base in Bahrain
• Both are claims from a briefing synthesis, not facts we have independently confirmed
➜ PRODUCER FLAG: check fresh sources before air, and do not treat the claims as confirmed. Possible gas-price angle only if you've got a number you can stand behind.
➜ BAIT: Skip the bait unless the facts are locked.

━━ BITS ━━
• Last day at the Buck Pole: you going, or are you already telling the story of the one that got away?
• Rock Hall: Oasis, Queen Latifah, Sade, Joy Division/New Order, Iron Maiden, Rick Rubin — who belonged in there years ago?
• GTA 6 is out Thursday. Who's taking the day, and who's waiting for the weekend?

━━ SPORTS ━━

• Vikings 30, Packers 10
• Mahomes threw 5 TDs as the Chiefs beat the Falcons 35–13
• Bills 31, Jets 12 · Browns 27, Texans 24 · Colts 24, Dolphins 22

• College upsets: Florida 21, No. 11 Kentucky 14; Arkansas 34, No. 17 South Carolina 6; Colorado 42, No. 14 Houston 32; Texas beat LSU; No. 2 Utah edged No. 23 Arizona to stay unbeaten

mental.title: Mental Health Minute
mental.content:
MOCK RUN — test sheet, not for air

Give the Soft Monday a Real Chance

Today is the International Day for Tolerance, and the weather is actually on our side: mostly sunny, around 50, and no advisory hanging over the drive. After a weekend of delayed flights, tense sports living rooms, and a lot of leftover aggravation, it's easy to carry Sunday's mood into Monday and take it out on the first person who cuts you off or sends a sharp text. Here's your move for today. Pick one moment this morning — the walk from the car, the first cup of coffee, or the first song — and use it to reset your voice before you talk to anybody. Tolerance isn't a speech. It's leaving the person in front of you a little more room than you got this weekend. That's your Mental Health Minute on Z93. Text me at 231-929-4487 and tell me what your reset moment was.
mental.notes: MOCK RUN — not for air. Aimed at the adult in the driver's seat. Hooks are the UN International Day for Tolerance (already in days.json) and the mild, dry Monday forecast. No clinical claims. Advice is a practical reset, not a diagnosis.
